title: Assessment of machine-learning predictions for the Mediator complex subunit MED25 ACID domain interactions with transactivation domains.
authors: Monte, Didier; Lens, Zoe; Dewitte, Frederique; Villeret, Vincent; Verger, Alexis
one_liner_zh: 该文用AlphaFold等深度学习方法预测并评估人类MED25 ACID结构域与转录激活域TAD的互作界面，属于蛋白-DNA/蛋白-转录因子相关互作建模，但对象为蛋白-蛋白而非TF-DNA，方法可迁移，故评7分。
abstract: The human Mediator complex subunit MED25 binds transactivation domains (TADs) present in various cellular and viral proteins using two binding interfaces, named H1 and H2, which are found on opposite sides of its ACID domain. Here, we use and compare deep learning methods to characterize human MED25-TAD interfaces and assess the predicted models to published experimental data. For the H1 interface, AlphaFold produces predictions with high-reliability scores that agree well with experimental data, while the H2 interface predictions appear inconsistent, preventing reliable binding modes. Despite these limitations, we experimentally assess the validity of MED25 interface predictions with the viral transcriptional activators Lana-1 and IE62. AlphaFold predictions also suggest the existence of a unique hydrophobic pocket for the Arabidopsis MED25 ACID domain.
abstract_zh: 人源Mediator复合物亚基MED25通过其ACID结构域两侧的两个结合界面（命名为H1和H2）与多种细胞和病毒蛋白中的转录激活结构域（TADs）结合。在此，我们使用并比较深度学习方法，以表征人源MED25-TAD界面，并将预测模型与已发表的实验数据进行评估。对于H1界面，AlphaFold产生的预测具有高可靠性评分，与实验数据吻合良好，而H2界面的预测则显得不一致，阻碍了可靠结合模式的确定。尽管存在这些局限性，我们仍通过实验评估了MED25界面预测对病毒转录激活因子Lana-1和IE62的有效性。AlphaFold预测还提示拟南芥MED25 ACID结构域存在一个独特的疏水口袋。
